verdict.rationale: Chargebee's RevRec docs state that it offers revenue recognition compliant with both ASC 606 and IFRS 15. The docs also say it covers contract changes such as renewals, modifications and cancellations, so the core of the story is met. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of deferred revenue schedules, audit-ready recognition reports, documented flow from billing data into RevRec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
